result.summary: Pre-check (zig build test-env-verify) is now HEALTHY 10/10 (C3/C4/C5 all PASS — REWORK 1 fixed the prior FAIL). However, RUN 1 of the 5-run gate via scripts/run-test-integration.ps1 (-j8 default) failed with the EXACT GH-752 symptom still present: 8 'test runner failed to respond for ~1m+ms' entries (61–75 second timeouts) and 119 ServerError entries from pg_advisory_lock contention. Build summary: '87/117 steps succeeded (27 failed); 929/1023 tests passed (10 skipped, 84 failed)'. 32 distinct test files hit ServerError, plus 4 genuine test failures independent of GH-752 (TC-RG-01/02 baseline regression, TC-ISS-0185-03 dual-schema, TC-SCH-02-03 timer rollback). The -j8 cap is too lenient — the design's 8-default was not empirically justified. Controller halted at RUN 1 per handoff protocol.

issues.description: GH-752 symptom persists at -j8: 8 'test runner failed to respond for ~1m+ms' + 119 ServerError on pg_advisory_lock(hashtext('bpm_test_migrations_public')) during RUN 1. Build summary 87/117 steps succeeded. Controller halted at RUN 1; RUNs 2-5 not run.

Pre-existing test failures (not introduced by GH-752): (1) gh512_t010_regression_test.TC-RG-01 — T010 BLOCKER count regressed from ceiling 74 to 75 (new hardcoded UUID literal in tests/integration/); (2) gh512_t010_regression_test.TC-RG-02 — total_issues=117 vs expected=116 per GH-512 snapshot; (3) iss0185_dual_schema_test.TC-ISS-0185-03 — HYBRID tables test fails; (4) sch02_timer_polling_test.TC-SCH-02-03 — timer rollback expects TransactionFailed but gets .{ .fired = 1, .skipped_locked = 0 }. Should be filed as their own ISSes.

Design-vs-implementation gap: src/design/iss0692_test_integration_capacity_mitigation.md chose -j8 default without empirical justification. At -j8, 8 parallel test binaries contend for the single pg_advisory_lock('bpm_test_migrations_public') and the postgres connection pool. The 8 runner-timeout failures + 119 ServerError entries prove the cap is too high. ADHOC BACKEND-DEV handoff should empirically determine the right cap (likely 2 or 4) or diagnose whether the bottleneck is connection-pool starvation rather than job count.

result.next_action: Spawn ADHOC BACKEND-DEV handoff to (a) empirically determine the correct -j cap (try -j2 or -j4), (b) diagnose whether the underlying bottleneck is pg_advisory_lock contention or postgres connection-pool exhaustion, (c) consider increasing the zig test runner's 60s timeout. Then file the 4 pre-existing test failures as separate ISSes (TC-RG-01/02 baseline regression, TC-ISS-0185-03, TC-SCH-02-03). Re-dispatch TEST-RUNNER for the 5-run gate once the cap is fixed.
